items.t: Said daycares cannot turn a child away because of a parent’s medical decision.
items.q: Daycares can tell parents what they believe about vaccines and health, but they cannot turn a child away because of a parent’s medical decision.

items.t: Said protecting children in Idaho is one of the most critical responsibilities of his office.

record.q: FADA was introduced by Rep. Raúl Labrador (H.R. 2802) and Senator Mike Lee (S. 1598) and has 171 cosponsors.

record.t: Left the House immigration group after Democrats pushed for health care for illegal immigrants.
record.q: That prompted Labrador to abandon the group on Wednesday evening, as the left was not negotiating in good faith, he said. A House aide confirmed to Breitbart News that Pelosi–who was not a member of the House immigration group–was the leader of the charge in pushing health care for illegal immigrants

record.t: Abstained from voting for John Boehner for House speaker in 2013.
record.q: Labrador, an Idaho Republican, abstained from voting for Boehner in 2013 for the speakership, saying that there was no candidate for the post that he considered worthy.

record.t: Was elected to the U.S. House of Representatives in 2010 and served 8 years.
record.q: In 2010, I was elected to the U.S. House of Representatives where I served for 8 years.

record.t: Was elected to the Idaho Legislature in 2006 and served 4 years.
record.q: In 2006, I was elected to the Idaho Legislature where I served for 4 years.

record.t: Served as Chairman of the U.S. House Judiciary Subcommittee on Immigration and Border Security and served 8 years on the U.S. House Committee on Natural Resources.
record.q: In Congress, I was honored to serve as the Chairman of the U.S. House Judiciary Subcommittee on Immigration and Border Security, and I also served for 8 years on the U.S. House Committee on Natural Resources.

record.t: Voted for John Boehner for another term as House speaker.
record.q: But on Tuesday, he voted for Boehner, an Ohio Republican, despite an effort by Labrador’s conservative colleagues to defeat his pursuit of another term as speaker.

record.t: Introduced a measure to shield groups and religious institutions opposed to same-sex marriage from being penalized by the federal government.
record.q: Rep. Raúl Labrador is introducing a measure on Thursday that shields groups and religious institutions opposed to same-sex marriage from being penalized by the federal government.

record.t: Obtained dismissal of the lawsuit Le Soleil Child Care v. Labrador, which challenged the Idaho Medical Freedom Act, when a federal court granted his motion to dismiss.
record.q: U.S. District Judge Amanda Brailsford granted Attorney General Labrador’s motion to dismiss in Le Soleil Child Care v. Labrador , rejecting every claim brought by a Boise-area daycare and three parents

record.t: Announced a $17.1 billion multistate settlement with Meta Platforms, Inc.
record.q: Attorney General Raúl Labrador announced today a staggering $17.1 billion multistate settlement with Meta Platforms, Inc.

record.t: Announced a lawsuit against OpenAI under the Idaho Consumer Protection Act.
record.q: Attorney General Raúl Labrador today announced a lawsuit against OpenAI for harms caused to Idaho children, deceiving parents, and violations of the Idaho Consumer Protection Act.

record.t: Announced a court victory won by Idaho with 14 other states in Silencer Shop Foundation, et al. v. Bureau of Alcohol, Tobacco, and Firearms and Explosives.
record.q: following the court victory Idaho won with 14 other states in Silencer Shop Foundation, et al. v. Bureau of Alcohol, Tobacco, and Firearms and Explosives

record.t: Joined 20 other attorneys general in urging Congress to repeal certain federal firearm registration and tax provisions permanently.
record.q: In September, Attorney General Labrador joined 20 other attorneys general in urging Congress to repeal these provisions permanently.
